package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for tests_stub_gin_context_instead_of_httptest_boundary: Handler tests that mock Gin internals directly instead of using `httptest` when boundary behavior matters.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func TestGetUserHandler(t *testing.T) {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)

	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	c, _ := gin.CreateTestContext(w)
	c.Request = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/users/1", nil)
	c.Params = gin.Params{{Key: "id", Value: "1"}}

	GetUser(c)

	if w.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("expected 200, got %d", w.Code)
	}
	expected := `{"id":1,"name":"test"}`
	if w.Body.String() != expected {
		t.Errorf("body = %s, want %s", w.Body.String(), expected)
	}
}

func GetUser(c *gin.Context) {
	id := c.Param("id")
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"id": id, "name": "test"})
}
